arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print('Sheets:', xl.sheet_names)
for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = xl.parse(name, header=None)
    print(f'\n=== Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===')
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=15))

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print('=== xl/workbook.xml ===')
    print(z.read('xl/workbook.xml').decode('utf-8'))
    print('\n=== xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels ===')
    print(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels').decode('utf-8'))
    print('\n=== xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml ===')
    print(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8'))
